measurement_description: The benchmark measures legal reasoning on law school exams. A small subset of the exam questions are from courses on 'Recht und Religion' (Law and Religion) and 'Kirchenrechtsgeschichte und Kirchenrecht' (Church Law History and Church Law), thus measuring knowledge of religious/church law as a minor component.
